Patch 1.62 — Ray Tracing: Overdrive Mode

Patch 1.62 for Cyberpunk 2077 is out now! This update brings the technology preview of Ray Tracing: Overdrive Mode for high-end PCs.

Together with NVIDIA, we’re bringing a completely new, fully ray-traced, aka path-traced, rendering mode to the game with this patch – Ray Tracing: Overdrive Mode. We’re proud of it. It pushes the boundaries of what's possible in technology. However, because it is so new and fundamentally different from what we've been using so far, we know it's not going to be perfect from the start and players might experience some issues – that’s why we’ve decided to call it a “Technology Preview”. This is a vision of the future that we want to share, and we're committed to continue working on and improving this feature.

The technology preview of Ray Tracing: Overdrive Mode is currently recommended on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 40 Series (4070 Ti and up) graphics cards. Also, on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 (1080p, 30 fps). As this is a cutting-edge feature, it requires the highest-performing hardware available to run it properly. Ray Tracing: Overdrive is very GPU intensive, therefore it’s set to ""off"" by default.

For other ray-tracing-capable PC graphics cards with at least 8GB VRAM, we included an option to render path-traced screenshots in Photo Mode. This is possible because it means rendering just one frame, as opposed to rendering several frames every second (i.e. FPS), which would happen when playing the game.

You'll find the list of changes for patch 1.62 below:

Path Tracing: Technology Preview

Added a Ray Tracing: Overdrive preset which includes the Path Tracing technology. You can enable the Ray Tracing: Overdrive preset in Settings > Graphics > Quick Preset, or just Path Tracing separately in Settings > Graphics in the Ray Tracing section. To make sure Ray Tracing: Overdrive Mode works correctly on your PC, update your NVIDIA Game Ready Driver to version 531.41 at minimum.
Additionally, we included an option to render path-traced screenshots in Photo Mode for other Ray-Tracing-capable graphics cards with at least 8GB VRAM. If you graphics card has more than 8GB VRAM and this option is still greyed out, it means you need to lower your in-game resolution. Note that the higher the resolution and the less powerful the GPU is, the longer it will take to take a screenshot (between a few seconds to several minutes). You can enable Path Tracing for Photo Mode in Settings > Graphics in the Ray Tracing section.

DLAA

Added NVIDIA DLAA, an AI-based anti-aliasing mode designed to improve image quality. DLAA requires a NVIDIA RTX graphics card. It can be enabled in Settings > Graphics in the NVIDIA DLSS section.

Intel XeSS

Added support for Intel Xe Super Sampling 1.1, an upscaling technology using machine learning to provide improved performance with high image quality. It can be enabled in Settings > Graphics in the Resolution Scaling section.

Benchmark improvements

Improved the Benchmark to display more information in the results screen, including PC specs, GPU driver version and selected settings.

DLSS 3 & Reflex PC Update

An update for Cyberpunk 2077 is out now. It adds support for NVIDIA DLSS 3 and NVIDIA Reflex on compatible hardware.

More information about DLSS can be found in this support article: https://cp2077.ly/DLSSen

Palworld v1.0 - Official Release Changelog

Palworld 1.0 - Changelog

Pal Tamers, the time has come.

Today, Palworld exits early access. Palworld 1.0 is here!

Sunreach, a mysterious new island floating in the sky…The World Tree, the heart of the Palworld story…Palpagos has grown, and a new adventure awaits.

Palworld 1.0 adds 72 new Pals to the world, bringing the total number of Pals up to an incredible 287! 

Palworld 1.0 also adds new ways to strengthen your Pals through Awakening and Mutation, rebalanced stats and abilities for all Pals, and large-scale overhauls across many aspects of the game, including base building, multiplayer, and graphics.

The journey that began in Early Access reaches its climax, and from here, a new Palworld begins.

▼ New Areas & World Improvements

● Sunreach

Floating above Palpagos, a new set of islands has appeared in the skies! Kept aloft by the power of Paldium, this land holds an environment unlike the surface, with a unique civilization that has taken root over long years.

Sunreach introduces a wide range of new content, including new Pals, tower bosses, and ores that can only be mined using specialized equipment.

Explore every corner of Sunreach and challenge the towers hidden above the clouds. What awaits you at the edge of the sky may be the still-unknown memories of this island…

● The World Tree

Why do the factions of the Palpagos Islands keep fighting over ownership of the towers? The mystery hidden on this island is finally revealed.

The key to the story of Palworld is the World Tree, towering over Palpagos, and it is here that players will face their greatest challenge yet. 

● Revamped World!

- Ancient Ruins

Ancient Ruins have been added across the world. Through exploration and minigames, you can earn valuable rewards such as schematics.

- Watchtowers

Watchtowers have been added in various locations. Accessing one reveals the surrounding map and lets it serve as a fast travel point, making exploration of uncharted areas easier.

- New Small Islands

A total of 7 new small islands have been added, with three distinct biomes: volcano, desert, and ruins. Each island serves its own purpose, and features Pals you can only encounter there.

- New Settlements

Small settlements have been added at the Bamboo Groves, the Snowy Mountains, Sakurajima, and Sunreach. Each settlement features new NPCs as well as sub-missions.

In addition, enemy bases have been added at sea, further expanding the stage for exploration and combat.

● Wildlife Sanctuary Overhaul!

Wildlife Sanctuaries, previously small islands, have been reworked as protected conservation areas established by an ancient civilization to preserve the natural environment. Each of the three sanctuaries has its own special environment with unique scenery, Pals that can only be found there, rare materials, and powerful bosses all await in these renewed sanctuaries.

Inside, defense drones operate to eliminate intruders. Sneak onto the islands and avoid the searchlights, or go in loud, the choice is up to you!

● Rebalanced Pal Habitats

We've reviewed the placement and spawn levels of Pals throughout the world. Pal spawns feel more natural for each region you explore, adding a new sense of fun and adventure in your search for Pals!

*For the random Pal spawn mode, to correctly reflect this rebalance, placement data from v0.7.3 and earlier is no longer carried over.

● Increased Player Level Cap

The player level cap has been raised from 65 to 80. Many new technologies related to the ancient civilization have been added.

● Other Adjustments & Improvements

Lifmunk Effigies has been reworked into "Pal Effigy." You can now collect effigies of various Pals to enhance the player's stats. (Lifmunk Effigies already obtained are carried over as is.)

Important: About MODs and 1.0!

Palworld and Pocketpair support modding, and we're grateful to all our fans who have dedicated time into modding the game up now. We look forward to seeing all the amazing MODs that will be made after 1.0.

However, if you haven't played the game in a long time then it is possible you may have old and potentially harmful MOD data still on your PC.

The upcoming 1.0 update for Palworld makes significant changes to the game’s systems. If you still have MODs installed from the past, especially MODs that have been left installed since around 2024, you may encounter problems such as:

・Crashes when launching or playing the game

・Corrupted save data or save data failing to load

・Quests or events becoming impossible to progress

Please Note! Simply turning MODs “off” or “disabling” them is not enough.

MOD files and MOD loaders that remain in the game folder may still be loaded when the game starts, even if they have been disabled, and can cause issues. Please manually delete these files before updating. If you have ever installed MODs in the past, even if they are currently turned off, please make sure to delete the files.

Recommended steps before updating

(1) Back up your save data

(2) Manually delete old MOD files from the game folder. \[Most Important!]

If any of the following files or folders remain, please delete them or move them to another location. Simply disabling them with a MOD management tool will not delete them.

Please check these guidelines for instructions on how to remove mods: https://guideline.palworldgame.com/palworld-mod-guideline

(3) Verify the integrity of your game files on Steam

Steam Library → Right-click “Palworld” → “Properties” → “Installed Files” → “Verify integrity of game files”

(4) Confirm that the game launches correctly in an unmodded state before applying the update

If you are using Steam Workshop MODs, please also unsubscribe from all installed MODs in addition to following the steps above. However, unsubscribing alone will not remove the remaining files mentioned in step (2), so manual deletion is still required.

Important note about save data

Save data that contains content dependent on MODs, such as added items or Pals, may not function correctly after those MODs are removed, or may become impossible to load. Please make sure to back up any important data in advance.

Reinstalling MODs

We recommend only reinstalling MODs after confirming that the MOD creators have updated them for 1.0, and then testing them one by one. Please note that issues that occur while using MODs, or modified game data, are not covered by support.

Thank you for your continued support of Palworld.

Palworld v0.7 - Home Sweet Home

2025 has been an incredible year for Palworld, and we’re excited to end the year with v0.7, Home Sweet Home! The purpose of this update is to begin improving existing features, and while this update may not be as content-rich as previous ones, we hope players understand that it’s necessary for us to begin laying the groundwork now as we work on the development of Palworld 1.0.

You can find more info about this in our Palworld 1.0 video here:

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/tEVIBHP37eM?si=K33bxXJNwmQWgnYX"]

Palworld v0.7 - Home Sweet Home! 

▼ ULTRAKILL Collaboration!

Palworld’s second collab, ULTRAKILL, finally arrives! 

This update adds several iconic weapons and armour, as well as a V1’s infamous coin toss! Thank you to New Blood and Hakita for allowing us to play with their incredible game, and we hope our fans will enjoy taking on battles in a fresh, stylish way with this special equipment!

▼ Improvements to Building

A big part of the Home Sweet Home update is, as the name suggests, your home! 

We have been blown away by all the incredible builds that you guys have been sending us, and we know that you have been eagerly waiting for more freedom in how you design your base. This update brings a large number of new building parts, including the much-requested triangular pieces!

Another new addition to the building system in this update is the ability to change the colour of building pieces! Express yourself in any way you feel like by adding a splash of your favourite colour to your home!

The building menu UI has been redesigned and reformatted into a list. You can now select the structures and parts you need more intuitively, which should result in an overall smoother building experience!

▼ Raid Battlefields!

When summoning a raid boss at the Summoning Altar, players can now choose to either fight at their base as before, or take on the raid boss in a special “Raid Area”.
These Raid Areas allow you to fight with all your might, without risking any damage to your base. You can build temporary structures and take items into these special Raid Areas.

That’s not all… A new raid boss has also appeared! Team up with your Pals and allies to take on this new formidable foe!

▼ Improved Melee Combat

Melee is often overlooked in the late game, so we wanted to start improving the system to make it more viable and fun for players. To that end, we have made improvements to the melee gameplay!

The basic attack actions for swords, katanas, and beam swords have been changed. You can now perform attacks consecutively by repeatedly pressing left click (right trigger on controller). In addition, special attacks have been added to katanas and beam swords. You can activate a special attack by holding down right click (left trigger on controller) and left click (right trigger on controller). Take your melee gameplay to the next level!

This is our first pass at improving the melee combat, and we have even more improvements planned to the melee system for 1.0! 

▼ Steam Workshop

We would like to express our deepest thanks to the Palworld modding community, who, since day 1 have been passionately making so many fun mods for Palworld. We have now added Steam Workshop to the game, allowing players to try out a variety of mods and discover new ways to play with greater ease! If you are interested in modding, please head over to the Steam Workshop for more details!

Please note that Steam Workshop is only available for the Steam version of Palworld.

Please also note that some servers, including official servers, prohibit the use of mods in order to ensure fair play. To that end, we recommend only using mods in single-player or with your friends.

A special thank you to Primarinabee and Okaetsu for their help and assistance with this feature!

For more information about modding and how to mod, please see the guidelines and documentation provided on our Steam Workshop or visit the Palworld modding…

What You Need To Know

Players must complete the Chains of Harrow Quest to access Follie’s Hunt located in the wreckage of the Vesper Relay on Venus.

Nightmare Mode Missions

These missions occur across the Origin System and offer unique challenges in order to complete them. To unlock Nightmare Mode on a planet, you must first complete every Mission node on that planet. Upon completing a Nightmare Mode Mission for the first time, you will receive 10 Nightmare Tatters. These time-limited missions will reset every eight hours and provide you with another way to collect Nightmare Tatters outside of the usual game mode!

What is Nightwave?

Experiencing this facet of Warframe for the first time? Nightwave is a pirate radio broadcast hosted by Nora Night, focused on the latest stories in the Origin System. Nightwave is also a series of Daily, Weekly and now permanent objectives. All of which offer new and useful (and often entirely unique) rewards!

Nightwave is available via the Orbiter’s Navigation console or through the Orbiter’s radio scanner (located on the left side of your Orbiter’s bridge). In the Nightwave menu, you’ll see your progress through the current season, your current Reward Tiers, as well as a rotating set of Daily, Weekly, Elite Weekly and Permanent Weekly Acts. windows:winget:Mozilla.Firefox.releaseNotes:
Version 159.0, first offered to Release channel users on October 27, 2026

New
- Sharing on macOS now uses the native macOS share picker, which shows a preview of the page and recent contacts alongside AirDrop, Messages, and other apps. Several selected tabs can also be shared at once.

- Saved passwords are now available from the sidebar by default, without having to add the Passwords tool first.

- Smart Window can now watch pages for changes such as price drops or restocks. Type /watch in the chat to set one up, and Firefox sends a desktop notification when it finds a match. Watches can be managed from the Tasks button in the toolbar or the about:smartwindowtasks page.
  This feature is part of a progressive roll out.
  What is a progressive roll out?
  Certain new Firefox features are released gradually. This means some users will see the feature before everyone does. This approach helps to get early feedback to catch bugs and improve behavior quickly, meaning more Firefox users overall have a better experience.

Fixed
- Fixed the file upload dialog opening in the last folder a file was saved to, such as Downloads, instead of the folder last used for uploads.
- Fixed memory usage growing rapidly when sites such as the Zoom web app were left open in a minimized window.
- Fixed some videos displaying incorrectly on Windows when NVIDIA RTX Video HDR is enabled.
- Fixed bookmarks not being imported from Google Chrome profiles that are signed in to a Google account.
- Fixed the Replace button in Apple Writing Tools on macOS inserting the clipboard contents instead of the rewritten text on some sites, such as Gmail.
- Fixed long drop-down lists on web pages sometimes showing blank space in place of the last options until the list was scrolled.
- Fixed some sites, such as Slack, failing to load instead of falling back to HTTP/2 when the site rejected an HTTP/3 request.
- Fixed Firefox using excessive memory on Linux with AMD graphics when viewing map or place results on sites such as ChatGPT.
- Fixed quick gamepad button presses sometimes being missed in web games on macOS.
- Fixed tabs sometimes detaching into a new window when clicked on Linux with Wayland.
- Fixed menus and panels fading in on Windows and Linux when animation effects are turned off in the operating system.
- Various security fixes.

Changed
- On macOS, apps that sign in through the default browser, such as ChatGPT, now open their sign-in page in Firefox instead of Safari when Firefox is the default browser.
- The AI chatbot's Summarize page option now sends the page's address to the chatbot provider instead of the page's text, so long pages are no longer cut short to a partial summary.
- Open tabs can now be searched with a keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+A on Windows and Linux, Cmd+Shift+A on macOS. The Extensions and Themes shortcut is now Ctrl+Shift+F on Windows and Linux, and Cmd+Shift+E on macOS. These shortcuts can be changed in about:keyboard.
- Web addresses written in the Javanese, Balinese, Canadian Aboriginal Syllabics, and N'Ko scripts are now displayed in their own script instead of as encoded "xn--" text.

Enterprise
- For Firefox Enterprise updates and fixes, see the Firefox Enterprise release notes. For policy changes, see the Firefox admin docs changelog.

Developer
- The Web Console now allows let, const, and class variables to be declared again, so a snippet can be edited and re-run without a redeclaration error.

Web Platform
- Firefox now supports scroll-driven animations, so CSS animations and Web Animations API animations can progress with the scroll position of a container or with an element's visibility as it scrolls into view. This adds the animation-timeline, scroll-timeline, view-timeline, and animation-range properties and the ScrollTimeline and ViewTimeline interfaces.
- Firefox now supports scoped custom element registries. A registry created with the CustomElementRegistry() constructor is separate from the global window.customElem…

Version 158.0, first offered to Release channel users on October 13, 2026

New
- You can now fill in forms faster in Smart Window. When clicking into a form field or selecting Fill from sources, Smart Window will now suggest data to use based on your relevant open tabs and saved autofill data.
  This feature is part of a progressive roll out.
  What is a progressive roll out?
  Certain new Firefox features are released gradually. This means some users will see the feature before everyone does. This approach helps to get early feedback to catch bugs and improve behavior quickly, meaning more Firefox users overall have a better experience.
- Firefox now creates more accessible PDFs when saving a page as PDF, and when printing on Linux and macOS. This also fixes a variety of PDF rendering issues, such as missing math symbols.
- Firefox now supports the JPEG XL image format, which generally has better compression than WebP, JPEG, PNG, and GIF.
- New Tab now keeps a library of custom wallpapers under Your images, rather than only the most recent one.
- Firefox's translations feature now supports the following languages:
  - Albanian
  - Belarusian
  - Filipino

Fixed
- Fixed website icons (favicons) in address bar results blending into the highlight color when selecting a result with the keyboard on Ubuntu's default theme.
- Fixed a crash that could occur while Firefox loaded website icons (favicons).
- Fixed the first letter of each search engine's name being underlined in the Unified Search Button menu in the address bar on Windows and Linux, which could cause conflicting keyboard shortcuts.
- Fixed menus such as List all tabs, Settings, and Unified Search being hard to read with a Windows High Contrast theme. Menu background and text colors now follow the Background and Text colors chosen for a custom contrast theme in Windows Settings.
- Various security fixes.

Changed
- Firefox no longer rounds scroll positions to whole screen pixels. Scrolling is now smoother and more precise, especially on high-resolution displays or when a page is zoomed.

Enterprise
- For Firefox Enterprise updates and fixes, see the Firefox Enterprise release notes. For policy changes, see the Firefox admin docs changelog.

Developer
- Fixed an issue where the Network Monitor could miss WebSocket messages if they arrived immediately after a connection was established.

Web Platform
- Firefox now supports typed arithmetic in CSS calc(), allowing units to be multiplied and divided within math functions.
- Added support for the navigate option for the Notification constructor and ServiceWorkerRegistration.showNotification(), which specifies a URL to navigate to when the notification is clicked.
- The WebAuthn conditional UI is now shown on input elements with an autocomplete="webauthn" attribute. Previously, it was only shown when the attribute included another autofill field value, such as autocomplete="username webauthn". (Learn more)
- Firefox now supports the cache value for PerformanceResourceTiming.deliveryType, allowing websites to identify resources served from the HTTP cache.
- The WebGL extension EXT_polygon_offset_clamp is now available on compatible devices.

windows:winget:TorProject.TorBrowser.releaseNotes:
Tor Browser 16.0 is now available for Desktop and Android. This is our first stable release based on Firefox ESR 153, incorporating a year's worth of changes that have been shipped upstream in Firefox. As part of this process, we've also completed our annual ESR transition audit, where we reviewed and addressed over 270 Bugzilla issues covering changes in Firefox that could negatively affect the privacy and security of Tor Browser users.

What's new for Desktop?

Redesigned Settings
Tor Browser connects millions of people to the Tor network (and by extension, the free and open internet) out of the box. However, for those who need to circumvent advanced censorship, boost their security level, or tailor their browsing experience, clear and easy-to-use Settings are essential. To that end, Tor Browser 16.0 introduces a complete redesign of the Settings experience based on a parallel redesign shipped in Firefox in June. Improvements include a cleaner layout, updated navigation, and clearer labels and descriptions aimed at making settings easier to find, understand, and manage. Other noteworthy changes include:
- The long-standing "General" page has been retired, with its contents distributed across new pages for Appearance, Downloads, Tabs and browsing, Accessibility and Languages.
- Pages and components that are unique to Tor browser like Connection and Security Level have been rebuilt from scratch using Firefox's new components so they look and feel consistent with the rest of Settings.
- Some settings that, if enabled, could compromise your privacy or make your browser easier to fingerprint have either been hidden or feature clear warnings.
Fear not: your existing preferences will remain saved even if the original setting has moved or changed, and you can use the search bar at the top of Settings to find anything you're struggling to track down.

Generic window titles
Another new addition to Settings is the option to use generic window titles, which can be found under Privacy and security → Protections from third‑party applications. Like most browsers, Tor Browser uses the title of the page you're currently viewing for the names of its windows. However, other applications on your computer or your operating system itself can read these titles without special permissions. When enabled, this option simply replaces all window titles with "Tor Browser" — preventing other software from snooping on your browsing history. As always, for more comprehensive protection from third‑party applications on your device, we recommend using Tails.
For now, this option is strictly opt‑in, as we did not have sufficient time during this release cycle to properly evaluate potential side‑effects for users. In particular, we worry that enabling this setting may reduce the browser's usability for those who rely on accessibility tools (e.g. screen‑readers) or those with highly customized systems (e.g. less‑popular desktop managers, application switchers, etc). If you are one of these users, we would ask that you try using this setting, and report back any bugs or usability issues you find!
📣 Generic window titles have also been upstreamed to Firefox as part of the Tor Uplift Project. Advanced Firefox users can enable this feature by opening about:config and setting privacy.exposeContentTitleInWindow (for normal windows) and privacy.exposeContentTitleInWindow.pbm (for private browsing windows) to false.

New user manual
The Tor Browser manual, which can be found by visiting about:manual or through the application menu (☰) → Help → Tor Browser manual, has also received a complete revamp. Since the release of our new Support portal in 2025, the team has had to maintain two sets of documentation: one for the traditional manual that's available to read in Tor Browser, and another for the new Support site.
